# Negative marking calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/negative-marking/

Calculate exam marks from correct, incorrect and unanswered questions. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Score 60 correct and 20 wrong answers where each correct answer earns one mark and each wrong answer loses 0.25.

## Limits and checks

Enter the exact scheme used by your exam. This tool does not assume that every exam uses the same penalty or rounding policy.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
